About.title: About me
About.eyebrow: Four years of daily project practice
About.lead: My strength is not one specific framework, but structured problem-solving with AI, agents and automation — from the first idea to a verified result.
paragraphs: Around four years ago, I completed roughly 80 percent of the classical frontend roadmap on roadmap.sh. This gave me foundations in HTML, CSS, JavaScript and React, without presenting myself as a finished framework specialist.

Since then, I have programmed with AI every day. This work has produced more than 20 personal projects and over 100 scripts, integrations and automations. I clarify requirements, break down tasks, orchestrate agents, test results and improve them iteratively.

My particular strength is advanced work with AI agents and large development workflows. I am looking for a junior or entry-level role where I can combine this delivery ability with code reviews, teamwork and professional processes.
